changeSet.author: vbusch

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT s.subscription_number, s.start_date, s.org_id, s.sku, s.billing_provider, s.billing_provider_id, s.billing_account_id FROM subscription s JOIN contracts c ON c.subscription_number = s.subscription_number AND c.start_date = s.start_date AND c.org_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.org_id AND c.sku IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.sku AND c.billing_provider IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.billing_provider AND c.billing_provider_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.billing_provider_id AND c.billing_account_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.billing_account_id GROUP BY s.subscription_number, s.start_date, s.org_id, s.sku, s.billing_provider, s.billing_provider_id, s.billing_account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.vendor_product_code) > 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT c.license_id) > 1 ) ambiguous_matches

changeSet.sql: UPDATE subscription s SET (vendor_product_code, license_id) = ( SELECT MAX(c.vendor_product_code), MAX(c.license_id) FROM contracts c WHERE c.subscription_number = s.subscription_number AND c.start_date = s.start_date AND c.org_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.org_id AND c.sku IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.sku AND c.billing_provider IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.billing_provider AND c.billing_provider_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.billing_provider_id AND c.billing_account_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.billing_account_id ) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM contracts c WHERE c.subscription_number = s.subscription_number AND c.start_date = s.start_date AND c.org_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.org_id AND c.sku IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.sku AND c.billing_provider IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.billing_provider AND c.billing_provider_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.billing_provider_id AND c.billing_account_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.billing_account_id )
